mapper.select: select a.*, FORMAT(a.wdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS formatted_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE_TAIL b WHERE b.info_num = a.num) AS tail_count from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE a where 1=1 and a.flag = 'Y' and a.chk_del = 'N' order by a.num desc
select *,FORMAT(wdate, 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_ID(id) as id2, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_NAME(writer) writer2 from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE where num = #{num}

SELECT * FROM ( select *,FORMAT(wdate , 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date, FORMAT(wdate, 'HH:mm') AS formatted_time, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_ID(id) as id2, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_NAME(writer) writer2 from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE_TAIL where info_num = #{info_num} ) A ORDER BY num

select top 8 a.*,FORMAT(a.wdate, 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_NAME(writer) writer2, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.num) AS rownum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE_TAIL b WHERE b.info_num = a.num) AS tail_count from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE a where 1=1 and a.chk_del = 'N' and a.id = #{id}
mapper.update: merge into KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE A using ( select #{num} AS num ,#{subject} AS subject ,#{content} AS content ,#{id} AS id ,#{writer} AS writer ,#{ip} AS ip ,#{chk_m} AS chk_m ) B on A.num = B.num WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE set A.subject = B.subject ,A.content = B.content WHEN not MATCHED THEN INSERT ( subject ,content ,flag ,id ,writer ,ip ,wdate ,chk_del ,visited ,ref ,step ,ansnum ,tn ,pn ,recommend ,chk_m ) values ( B.subject ,B.content ,'N' ,B.id ,B.writer ,B.ip ,getdate() ,'N' ,0 ,(SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ref), 0) + 1 FROM KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE) ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,0 ,B.chk_m );
update KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_FREE set chk_del = 'Y' where num= #{num}
